sandbachFocus: League leaders Sandbach United host Alsager Town on Saturday at 15:00, looking to extend their impressive recent run. Sandbach are unbeaten in their last five matches (four wins and a draw) and currently sit top of the table with 22 points from 10 games, holding a two-point advantage over second-placed Stafford Town. They face a struggling Alsager Town side who are second-bottom with just 4 points and have lost five of their last six outings.
divisionWide: The title race remains competitive with Stafford Town, currently second on 20 points, travelling to Dawley Town on Saturday. Third-placed AFC Bridgnorth host Eccleshall in a fixture between sides with strong recent form—AFC Bridgnorth are unbeaten in their last five while Eccleshall have won four of their last five. Fourth-ranked Wolverhampton Casuals face a stern test at home against Wednesfield Community. In-form Bilston Town (17 points) take on Foley Meir, while Barnton host Shawbury United in a clash between mid-table sides. New Mills travel to Market Drayton Town in a battle between struggling teams, Cheadle Heath Nomads visit Telford Town at the bottom of the standings, and Crewe host Allscott Heath in another lower-half encounter. Brereton Social face Widnes Town, who occupy the basement with just 2 points and a goal difference of -23, making them heavy underdogs.
